evidence.detail: Recovered semantic source map identifies rs/cache/b/f as rs.cache.updater.BrowserHyperlinkListener.
Exact v308 class implements javax.swing.event.HyperlinkListener and reacts only to ACTIVATED events by browsing the event URL through Desktop.getDesktop().browse(URI.create(...)).

R23 AssetVersion constructs this listener on the JEditorPane used by its connection/update error dialog containing the SpawnPK forums hyperlink; the class has no unrelated state beyond its synthetic AssetVersion owner reference.

candidates.note: Source-proven asset/update browser-link listener with exact-v308 behavioral corroboration.
